title: PRD-02 synthetic risk input syntax

vehicleRef.description: required; authorized vehicle record. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: VEHICLE_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

declaredValue.description: required; positive integer minor units, explicit currency/unit. Sensitivity: financial. Error: VALUE_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

accessories.description: optional; <= 100 items; unique item IDs with description <= 200 and money value. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: ACCESSORY_SCHEDULE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

perilCodes.description: required; 1–30 distinct contract-offered codes. Sensitivity: internal. Error: PERIL_COMBINATION_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

deductibleOption.description: required; 1–40 characters from chosen plan. Sensitivity: internal. Error: DEDUCTIBLE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

inspectionRef.description: conditional before issuance; approved, current inspection bound to this vehicle/version. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: INSPECTION_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

territoryCode.description: required; versioned jurisdiction/territory code <= 40. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: TERRITORY_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
